name: agent-hangar
description: One home for every AI agent. Build, test and ship agents once, then use them from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code or Slack (MCP, OpenAI-compatible, A2A, ACP). Self-hosted, with teams, approvals, audit, memory and multi-agent composition. Docker or Kubernetes.

paragraphs: One home for every AI agent your company builds, whatever tool built it.

People create agents where they already work: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, OpenCode. Agent Hangar brings them all to one place, runs each one in its own container, and makes them usable from any platform, over OpenAI-compatible, MCP, A2A and ACP. Everyone can find them, talk to them, and combine them into new agents.
